attchmntText: Nitin Fire Protection Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nitin Fire Protection Industries Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone results show a loss before tax of 87.46 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a profit of 246.8 lakh rupees in the same period last year. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a loss before tax of 216.25 lakh rupees, versus a profit of 1316.59 lakh rupees in the previous year. The statutory auditors issued an unqualified conclusion on the standalone results. The company has filed an interlocutory application for cancellation and issuance of fresh equity shares. Pending the outcome, the share capital structure remains unchanged.
